Callout.Name: Barn Broken Into
Callout.Message: Feed store and tools taken from a barn.

Script.Line: The padlock was cut with croppers. That is all I know about it.
Feed and the chainsaw. That is what has gone.
There is a truck comes down this lane most nights. Nobody should be down here.

Lines.Approach: Door forced and they cleared the tools out in the night. Nobody heard a thing.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
